stay.tokyo: Shinjuku is next to the start; Tokyo Station area is next to the finish. Book early: the city fills up on race weekend.
stay.boston: Stay in Back Bay near the finish on Boylston Street. Official buses to the start in Hopkinton leave from Boston Common.
stay.london: Stay central, near the finish on The Mall, or in Greenwich, Blackheath or the City for easy trains to the start.
stay.capetown: Green Point and the V&A Waterfront are walking distance from the start and finish.
stay.sydney: Stay in North Sydney near the start, or in the CBD / Circular Quay near the Opera House finish.
stay.berlin: Stay in Mitte or Tiergarten, close to the start and finish at the Reichstag and Brandenburg Gate.
stay.chicago: Stay in the Loop or South Loop, walking distance from the start and finish in Grant Park.
stay.nyc: Stay in Midtown Manhattan: race buses and ferries to the Staten Island start leave from there, and Central Park (finish) is close.
stay.shanghai: Stay near the Bund for the start; metro line 4 goes to the Shanghai Stadium finish.
stay.valencia: Stay near the City of Arts and Sciences, where the race starts and finishes, or in the old town.
stay.paris: Stay in the 8th or 16th arrondissement, near the Champs-Élysées start and the Avenue Foch finish.
stay.athens: Stay in central Athens (Syntagma, Plaka) near the Panathenaic Stadium finish; official buses take runners to the start in Marathon.
stay.amsterdam: Stay in Oud-Zuid near the Olympic Stadium, or anywhere central with a direct tram.
stay.rome: Stay near the Colosseum or Via dei Fori Imperiali, where the race starts and finishes.
stay.honolulu: Stay in Waikiki; the start is downtown and the finish is in Kapiolani Park, a short walk from most hotels.
